About ICF Gambia

Our history, mission & vision

"Welcome and thank you for your visit today. We are delighted to have you visit International Christian Fellowship Solution Centre. Our prayer is that you experience the love, presence, and transforming power of our Lord Jesus Christ as you fellowship with us."
— Pastor Mrs. Cecilia Romano & Evangelist Daniel Romano

Our History

ICF Gambia is blessed to welcome people from all walks of life into the ministry. Through fellowship, discipleship, worship, outreach to the marginalized, church planting, and the teaching of God's Word, the ministry is committed to rebuilding lives, transforming communities, and restoring hope to families and individuals, both young and old.

The Solution Centre branch, known as The Crusaders, is located in Mariama Kunda, Kombo North — a vibrant hub of ministry, prayer, and community transformation in The Gambia, West Africa.

🎯 Mission Statement

To glorify God by making disciples of all nations — through evangelism, discipleship, church planting, and compassionate outreach — empowering every believer to fulfill the Great Commission in the power of the Holy Spirit.

🌟 Vision Statement

To be a Spirit-filled, Word-centered community of believers that transforms families, communities, and nations — planting thriving churches, raising dedicated disciples, and demonstrating the love of Christ to the marginalized and unreached.

What We Believe
📖
Scripture
The Bible is the inspired, infallible Word of God — the final authority for faith and life.
✝️
Salvation
Salvation comes through faith in Jesus Christ alone — His death, burial, and resurrection.
🕊️
Holy Spirit
We believe in the baptism of the Holy Spirit and the operation of spiritual gifts today.
⛪
The Church
The universal Church — the body of Christ — called to worship, fellowship, and mission.
💧
Baptism
We practice water baptism by immersion as a public declaration of faith in Jesus Christ.
🌍
Great Commission
Committed to fulfilling the Great Commission — making disciples of all nations (Matthew 28:19).

🌍 Featured Mission

Fofuo Mission Outreach — July 22, 2026

Location: Fofuo, The Gambia

The ICF mission team continued its ongoing outreach and church-planting work in Fofuo, The Gambia. The day brought together children, youths, and adults for worship, teaching, prayer, fellowship, and community engagement.

Women received teaching focused on healthy marriage, while the children and youths joined together in joyful praise and worship. The team also prayed with the children and adults, and spent time listening to the experiences and challenges of the community.

The outreach reflects a mission journey that began approximately eight years ago and continues to grow through prayer, service, love, and genuine relationships within the community. What began as a cautious welcome has, over time and through consistent, unconditional love and service, grown into a warm and trusted relationship with the Fofuo community.

Membership, Mission & Statement of Belief

Becoming a member of ICF is more than joining an organisation — it's becoming part of the family of God. Below you'll find what membership means, what it asks of you, and the official document in full.

🤝 Belonging

Members are loved, prayed for, and supported by the church family — with counsel, teaching, and practical support in times of need.

🙏 Unity & Responsibility

Members commit to protecting church unity, sharing in its growth, and handling disagreements in a Scriptural, loving way.

🛠️ Serving

Every member is encouraged to discover their gifts and take part in serving within at least one ministry of the church.

✝️ Faith

Membership is grounded in our Statement of Belief — the Bible as God's Word, the Trinity, salvation through Christ, and a life of obedience and witness.
